solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

parts.note: O is the figure nought, a nil or no score
scars are marks left on the skin, blemishes

explanation.surface: A competition gives out prizes that are flawless.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oscars are the Academy Awards given each year for film.

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
an Audi is a German make of car

explanation.surface: Someone wants a compact vehicle suitable for a man from the Gulf.
explanation.definitionFit: A Saudi is a native of Saudi Arabia, so an Arab by nationality.

indicators.note: an injury knocks the sprinter's name out of shape, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The famous Jamaican sprinter washes off after getting hurt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after injury' rearranges USAINBOLT into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ablutions are acts of washing oneself, of which showers are an everyday kind.

clue.text: Drink for son, German, at start of the year

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for son, as in family trees
Herr is the German title for a man, so stands for a German

indicators.note: start of says only the opening letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: A drink is poured for a boy and a German man as the new year begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherry is a fortified wine from Spain, a type of drink.

clue.text: Without him, you'll have nothing to do

definitions.text: Without him, you'll have nothing to do

parts.words: Without him, you'll have nothing to do
parts.note: read as a warning about idleness, but it means the person who sets the very puzzle you are solving; with no setter there is no grid to fill in

explanation.surface: Someone is told that only one man keeps them busy.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across two lights, 5 down then 5 across.
explanation.definitionFit: The setter of a crossword gives the solver the task in hand, so without that person there is no pastime at all.

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so the girl's word goes round the part

parts.note: miss is a young unmarried woman, a girl
the lead is the starring role in a play or film

explanation.surface: A young woman tells lies about getting the main role in a show.
explanation.definitionFit: To mislead someone is to lead them into error, that is to deceive them.

indicators.note: topping means cutting off the head, so the first letter is removed

parts.note: dicing, as in dicing with death, is taking big risks

explanation.surface: A gambler stakes everything on the final flourish of a cake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topping' looks like part of the cake picture but is the signal to remove D from the front of DICING.
explanation.definitionFit: Icing is the sugary covering used to decorate cakes.

indicators.note: mad suggests the number written out is thrown into disorder

parts.note: the number 16 is spelt out as a word
CE stands for the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone aged sixteen is furious about the Church.
explanation.walkthrough: '16' looks like a cross-reference to another light, but here it is just the number written out in words; 'mad' is the anagram signal for it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being as a noun means the state of existing, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Birds moult — one's leg is broken

indicators.note: is broken tells us the gathered letters are smashed and reassembled

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I and the 's is S

explanation.surface: Birds shed their feathers, and one of them has a fractured leg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is broken' rearranges MOULT, IS and LEG together.
explanation.definitionFit: Guillemots are black-and-white seabirds of the auk family.

indicators.note: from says the answer is taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A flower is picked on a remote Scottish island.
explanation.walkthrough: Fair Isle is a small Shetland island known for patterned knitwear; 'from' points to the letters inside fAIR ISle.
explanation.definitionFit: The iris is a garden plant with showy flowers.

clue.text: Entertainments having cuts ripe for change

indicators.note: for change says the letters are to be altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Shows are edited because the cuts are overdue.
explanation.definitionFit: The pictures is an old British term for the cinema, a form of entertainment.

indicators.note: reportedly says the word is heard as spoken rather than read

parts.note: aits are small river islands, especially on the Thames

explanation.surface: Boat teams are said to be based offshore.
explanation.definitionFit: An eight is a rowing crew of eight oarsmen, so crews are eights.

clue.text: 'Huge' returns, doubled, are not up to much

indicators.note: doubled says the turned piece is written twice
returns says the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: OS stands for outsize, meaning huge

explanation.surface: Large takings repeated twice still disappoint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns OS into SO, and 'doubled' repeats it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mediocre or middling is described as not up to much.

clue.text: Phone round on river for hospitality for everyone

indicators.note: round suggests turning the letters about into another order

parts.note: the Ouse is a river in England (there are several)

explanation.surface: Someone rings round about a riverside party open to all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' is the anagram signal; in a down clue 'on' means the first piece sits above the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping open house means welcoming any visitor freely, so it is hospitality offered to all.

definitions.meaning: in rhyming slang china plate means mate
Cathay is the old European name for China

explanation.surface: A Londoner's mate comes from the Far East.
explanation.walkthrough: A Cockney is a working-class Londoner, known for rhyming slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Old china is rhyming slang for a pal, and Cathay was the historical name of that country.

definitions.meaning: breaking up soil with a farm harrow is literally work in a field

explanation.definitionFit: Harrowing means agonising; it is also the farming task of drawing a harrow over ploughed land.

indicators.note: form of signals a new shape made from the letters

explanation.surface: The happiest kind of boats.
explanation.definitionFit: Triremes were ancient galleys with three banks of oars, a type of boat.

definitions.meaning: found the length of something with a ruler or tape

explanation.surface: Someone went to great lengths to stay calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Measured is the past tense of measure, and as an adjective means calm and deliberate.

indicators.note: leaving says the letter goes out of the word

parts.note: a revel is a wild party or orgy
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Five people walk out of a wild party to go dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: A reel is a lively Scottish country dance.

parts.note: re means concerning or about
to call on someone is to visit

explanation.surface: Memory skills are discussed with regard to a visit.
explanation.definitionFit: Recall as a noun is the power of bringing things back to mind, memory.

definitions.meaning: a short drink taken after another, such as a whisky after beer
a horse that runs in steeplechases over fences

explanation.surface: A drink for a horse racing in a famous race.
explanation.walkthrough: The Grand National is Britain's best-known steeplechase, run at Aintree.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaser is a drink following another, and also a steeplechase horse.

indicators.note: in places the letter inside the joint word

parts.note: a seam is a joint where two pieces meet

indicators.note: first says only the opening letter is wanted

explanation.surface: Damp was first detected in a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: Steam is water vapour, a form of moisture.

clue.text: Gain entry violently for rescue of characters

indicators.note: characters means letters, here reshuffled to form a new phrase

explanation.surface: Breaking in is justified to save someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' signals working with the letters of RESCUEOF, rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To use force to get in is to break in, entering violently.

clue.text: Strongbox for game isn't finished on time

indicators.note: isn't finished says the word loses its final letter

parts.note: chess is a board game

explanation.surface: A safe is needed because a match has run out of time.
explanation.definitionFit: A chest is a large strong box for keeping valuables.

clue.text: In France, it is Moon River

definitions.meaning: a river in north-west England flowing through Lancaster

explanation.surface: A French reference to the song title about the moon.
explanation.definitionFit: Lune is French for moon and also an English river.

clue.text: Moderately short dogs head off to balconies

indicators.note: short says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: mezzo is the musical term for moderately

indicators.note: head off says the first letter is removed

parts.note: canines are dogs

explanation.surface: Somewhat small dogs go up to the balconies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims MEZZO to MEZZ and 'head off' cuts CANINES to ANINES.
explanation.definitionFit: Mezzanines are intermediate floors or theatre balconies.

clue.text: May I have a look, while I think about it?

definitions.meaning: a phrase used to buy time while pondering

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase asks to view something and is also said when pausing to reflect.

clue.text: Emissary cutting off beneficiary from will

indicators.note: cutting off says the final letter is lopped away

parts.note: a legatee is someone who receives a legacy under a will

explanation.surface: An envoy is disinherited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting off' removes the last E from LEGATEE; the surface pun is on cutting someone off from a will.
explanation.definitionFit: A legate is an envoy, especially one representing the Pope.
